# ezghcloud_database_backup (Resource)

A manual backup of a database. It outlives the database; destroying it deletes the backup.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) Database (dbi_) to back up. It can't change, and a replacement of the database is refused while this backup names its ID: either would delete the backup. To keep it past a replacement, write the dbi_ ID as a literal rather than the database's id attribute.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier. It can't change: a replacement would delete the backup.

### Optional

- `operation_timeout` (String) Maximum wait for the backup, for example 60m.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was taken.
- `engine` (String) Engine of the database it was taken of.
- `engine_version` (String) Engine version it was taken at.
- `expires_at` (String) When it expires; null for a manual backup kept until deleted.
- `id` (String) Backup ID (dbb_).
- `kind` (String) manual.
- `operation_id` (String) The operation that took the backup; unavailable on import.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `size_bytes` (String) Size as an exact decimal byte count.
- `status` (String) What the backup is doing.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_database_backup.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/RESOURCE_ID'
```
